reproduce: Check out base_commit in a separate checkout and apply candidate.patch.
Write the selected config to a fresh HPR_HOME/research/config.json.

Run python hpr.py run <case prompt> --tier light --preset lean --lang <case lang> --format facts --max-calls 8 --replay <absolute fixtures.json> --case <case_id> --run-id trial --plan-json to inspect without a model call.
Remove --plan-json only to run the actual, token-consuming replay. Never reuse a previous run directory.
